item.title: AA25-141A: Russian GRU Targeting Western Logistics Entities
item.description: CISA, FBI, and NSA released this joint advisory on Russian GRU actors conducting espionage against Western logistics companies, exploiting public-facing applications and using command injection for privilege escalation.

item.title: AA25-100B: PRC State-Sponsored Actors Compromise Telecom Networks
item.description: CISA and partners detail PRC-nexus Volt Typhoon activity using authentication bypass and SQL injection against telecom infrastructure.

item.title: CISA Releases Secure by Design Alert
item.description: A non-AA alert about secure design principles.

item.title: #StopRansomware: Interlock Ransomware
item.description: CISA and FBI released this joint guide on Interlock ransomware operators using drive-by download and remote code execution for initial access.
